Name: BeeboScore
Author: Beebo
Description: Control BeeboScore — scores, splashes, start.gg and game formats — from your Stream Deck.

Actions.Name: Match · Player score
Actions.Tooltip: Tap +1, hold −1. Shows the player's name and live score.

Actions.Name: Match · Set player
Actions.Tooltip: Pop-up to type a name or pick a player.

Actions.Name: Match · Losers [L]
Actions.Tooltip: Mark a player as coming from losers.

Actions.Name: Match · Swap sides
Actions.Tooltip: Swap Player 1 and Player 2.

Actions.Name: Match · Reset scores
Actions.Tooltip: Both scores back to 0–0.

Actions.Name: Match · Undo
Actions.Tooltip: Steps back one change. When the last thing that happened was a game format result, it takes that back instead (the key says UNDO RESULT).

Actions.Name: Match · Next set (clear players)
Actions.Tooltip: Clear both players for the next set.

Actions.Name: Match · FullVS / VS style
Actions.Tooltip: FullVS (the full VS splash) — or the VS style chosen in the app. Tap to show or hide; hold to switch between FullVS and GlassVS.

Actions.Name: Match · GlassVS
Actions.Tooltip: GlassVS: the glass lock-in VS — the two players face to face, pictures framed, names under them. Any match or format; stays up until you press again.

Actions.Name: Match · VS style (FullVS ⇄ GlassVS)
Actions.Tooltip: Switches what the VS key and the app's VS button play: FullVS or GlassVS. Shows the one chosen.

Actions.Name: Match · Victory splash
Actions.Tooltip: Show or hide the full-screen victory splash for the set winner.

Actions.Name: Match · Moment banners
Actions.Tooltip: Moment banners on or off: match point, comeback, sweep, upset, runback… said on stream by themselves. The key shows the one that’s up.

Actions.Name: Match · Replay the moment
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the last moment’s banner on stream again.

Actions.Name: Match · Head-to-head line
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the head-to-head of the two players on the scoreboard (from Player history) in a line on stream; press again to hide it.

Actions.Name: Match · Set timer
Actions.Tooltip: The set timer in the header: tap to start it, tap again to stop it (and again to start over). Hold to take it off the stream.

Actions.Name: Match · Stats strip
Actions.Tooltip: The stats strip under FullVS and GlassVS — each player's seed and record today, and the head-to-head or a runback between them. Press to switch it on or off.

Actions.Name: Match · Bracket reset splash
Actions.Tooltip: The Bracket reset splash: full screen, before the second Grand Final set. Press to show it, again to take it off. It also comes up by itself after the reset.

Actions.Name: Stream · Effects quality
Actions.Tooltip: Steps the layout effects through Auto, Full, Light and Ultra-light (for weak PCs), or sets one. The key shows the current level.

Actions.Name: Stream · Refresh OBS
Actions.Tooltip: Reloads the BeeboScore overlay in OBS (a fresh copy, swapped in seamlessly). Nothing else in OBS is touched.

Actions.Name: Stream · Hide all splashes
Actions.Tooltip: Takes every full-screen splash off at once — VS, Victory, Bracket, Top 8, Standings, the format and viewer splashes. The scoreboard stays.

Actions.Name: Stream · Stats card
Actions.Tooltip: Shows a player’s stats card on stream (record, characters, head-to-head from Player history); press again to hide it. Pick Player 1 or 2.

Actions.Name: Bracket · Next match (start.gg)
Actions.Tooltip: Load the next match from start.gg at 0–0.

Actions.Name: Bracket · Bracket splash
Actions.Tooltip: Show or hide the full-screen bracket (switches to the Top 8 splash once Top 8 is set).

Actions.Name: Bracket · Top 8 splash
Actions.Tooltip: Show or hide the Top 8 splash.

Actions.Name: Bracket · Top 8 standings
Actions.Tooltip: Show or hide the Top 8 standings splash (final placements). Works for start.gg events and viewer tournaments.

Actions.Name: Bracket · Winners / Losers side
Actions.Tooltip: Jump the bracket splash to the Winners or Losers side (big brackets). Brings the bracket up if it isn't on stream.

Actions.Name: Bracket · Report result to start.gg
Actions.Tooltip: Sends the finished set's result to start.gg (the match has to come from the start.gg bracket, and your account has to be able to report).

Actions.Name: Format · Confirm & next match
Actions.Tooltip: Game formats: the battle score; press to confirm a won set and load the next match.

Actions.Name: Format · Undo result
Actions.Tooltip: Game formats: undo the last recorded result.

Actions.Name: Format · Splash (board / team VS / champion)
Actions.Tooltip: Game formats: show / hide the board, Team VS or champion splash.

Actions.Name: Format · Format bar
Actions.Tooltip: Show / hide the format bar along the bottom of the layout (teams, survivors, challengers, standings). Lit while on stream.

Actions.Name: Format · Switch fighter
Actions.Tooltip: Team Death Battle: after a life is lost, puts the team's next fighter in (they keep their lives). Set P1 or P2.

Actions.Name: Format · Lock in
Actions.Tooltip: Team Death Battle: locks in the fighters picked for this battle (closes the switch window) — the Player VS pops up. Locked in too early? Press it again to undo.

Actions.Name: Format · Undo lock-in
Actions.Tooltip: Team Death Battle: takes back the last lock-in and opens the switch window again, until the next set is recorded. Lit while there's a lock-in to undo.

Actions.Name: BeeboScore key (follows the app)
Actions.Tooltip: Does whatever its place on the deck calls for: the match keys on the left, the format's keys on the right. Set up Stream Deck in the app fills a whole deck with these.
